title: Law of Sines Calculator
description: Solve triangles from AAS, ASA or SSA inputs — with the ambiguous SSA case reporting 0, 1 or 2 solutions.
howto: Pick the known case (AAS, ASA or SSA).
Enter the two angles/sides as labeled.
Press Solve triangle to see every solution with the working.

faqs.a: In SSA, the given side may swing to two positions, giving two different triangles — or none, if it cannot reach the base.

faqs.q: How do you detect zero solutions?
faqs.a: If side a is shorter than the altitude h = b·sin A, it cannot touch the base, so no triangle exists.
Yes — each candidate B is kept only if A + B < 180°, then side c is computed by the law of sines.
